summary: Pyxis Oncology filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 29, 2026 with Leerink, Guggenheim and Wells Fargo as representatives, covering an underwritten public offering of 36,047,919 shares plus pre-funded warrants for 1,883,121 shares, each bundled with common warrants for 1.3 shares. Combined price was $2.90 per share (or $2.899 per pre-funded unit); common warrants strike $3.50 and are exercisable only after stockholder approval of a charter amendment increasing authorized shares. Offering closed October 1, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
